name: Unfamiliar Boot Print
description: A boot print far larger than Colton's own gear, circling the collapsed tent twice.

name: Hotel Receipt
description: Owen's hotel receipt, timestamped the night before the disappearance -- leaving the actual night unaccounted for.

name: Lawsuit Papers
description: Court filings showing Owen stood to lose everything if Colton's patent priority was upheld next month.

name: Crushed Cigarette Butts
description: A brand Owen is known to smoke, found at the base of the watchtower.

name: Snare Line
description: One of Dale's illegal snare lines, strung well away from the camp itself.
